input.request: I can see that our supplier batch is marked processed, but I need to know whether the payment on row SUP-17 was paid or rejected.

events.text: I’m authorised to view our payouts. The batch shows processed, but I can’t tell whether row SUP-17, for our studio materials supplier, was paid. Please check that row’s status.
My first action is to look up row SUP-17 in the previously authorised batch and verify the status of that line specifically.

summary: Leona Voss, an unverified viewer writing over secure chat, asked the desk to check whether row SUP-17 in a payout batch marked processed was actually paid. The desk classed it as a status request, put the case in a waiting state because the payment system's answer has not come back, and closed it there. A second attempt to ask the payment system was refused because the case was already waiting, and nothing has been said to her about whether the row was paid, so someone still needs to reply once the payment system answers.
